cases.name: bp_mono
cases.why: MONOPHONIC — one voice, five notes. The case where two honest estimators SHOULD agree; the baseline for the metric.

cases.name: synthetic_voice
cases.why: MONOPHONIC with vibrato — the case where the two engines differ in their frame handling (a monophonic tracker follows the vibrato; a transcriber quantizes to notes).

cases.name: satb5
cases.why: POLYPHONIC — five voices at once. A monophonic tracker CANNOT see them all, so a high disagreement here is EXPECTED and is the honest limit of the cross-check (AGENTS §11: never promise perfect 5-way separation).

note: The `expected` block is computed by the PYTHON mirror of EngineCore's SwiftF0NoteSegmenter + TranscriptionCrossCheck; the Swift test asserts its own computation agrees with it, so the two implementations cannot drift apart silently.
